text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the modern workplace. One of the most visible effects is automation, where software handles repetitive tasks like data entry, scheduling, or answering routine customer questions. This frees up employees to focus on more complex and creative work. In addition, productivity tools powered by AI help with writing, analysis, and project management, saving time and reducing errors. However, the goal is not to replace people entirely but to create human-AI collaboration. Workers can supervise AI systems, interpret their results, and make final decisions. While some jobs will change or disappear, new roles will emerge, meaning that learning to work alongside AI is becoming an essential skill for everyone.
